context: Grading a shell script that finds large-context, currently-enabled GitHub Copilot models.

checklist.name: uses_fetch_models_or_api
checklist.description: Script invokes fetch-models.sh (or an equivalent direct API query) rather than `opencode models` or OpenCode's built-in listing.

checklist.name: uses_json_flag
checklist.description: Script requests structured JSON output suitable for `jq` parsing.

checklist.name: filters_policy_state
checklist.description: Script filters models using `.policy.state == 'enabled'` rather than listing all models.

checklist.name: reads_context_field
checklist.description: Script reads `.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens` (or equivalent) rather than inferring context size from the model name.

checklist.name: correct_output_format
checklist.description: Script outputs the model ID and context window size per qualifying model, one per line.

checklist.name: applies_threshold
checklist.description: Script filters for a context window of at least 100,000 tokens.
